content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I would like to request a small change before signing: - Under the relevant clause, liability is capped but excludes third-party and intellectual property claims, which leaves exposure unlimited. I propose changing this so that the aggregate liability of either party arising from the agreement is capped at USD 35,000. Best regards
